instruction: Walk to the green box and stop in front of it.
notes: Phase D.0e (Dr Sun 2026-09-14: 'run VLA episodes with a goal behind a box'). The target is 5 m straight ahead; a grey box at 2.5 m sits 0.35 m left of the straight line, so walking straight at the target puts the left legs 0.13 m into it (leg half-width 0.182 m), while about two thirds of the target stays visible to the head camera past the grey box's inner edge. Cameras as in the Phase C episodes.
